audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Yasuo/Yasuo/Skill/Skill/Mundo/Mundo/Mundo and handed the whole late game to Dr. Mundo, while whys[3] says 'From 4 your Wind Wall neutralizes his only poke tool', whys[4] 'his lack of CC lets you keep control at 6', whys[5] 'First-item crit Q out-scales his early sustain' and whys[6] 'your tempo and mobility fully outclass him'. Four rows rendered the opposite of their own explanation. diff also read TRICKY at 7.5/10 against a 51.4% win rate.
audit.why: Dr. Mundo's only window is level 3, where Infected Bonesaw poke plus Heart Zapper sustain out-chunks a Yasuo with one E target. After that Wind Wall answers his single projectile and his kit has no hard CC to pin a mobile Yasuo.
audit.corrected: Yasuo / Yasuo / Dr. Mundo / Yasuo / Yasuo / Yasuo / Yasuo — the packet chart. diff EVEN, diffRating 6/10, carryRating 6/10 as the mirror set them, with the three prose fields that quote those numbers updated to match. Rows proposed as a matched full+content group.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why and phases[4].why were template filler that named no ability and no number.
audit.why: Level 3 is his one spike, and level 6 is Maximum Dosage on a flat 120s healing a percentage of missing health — the reason you poke him below the reset rather than duel him. Last Breath needs him Airborne, which against Dr. Mundo means the two-stack Steel Tempest tornado.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why names the level-3 window; phases[4].why names Maximum Dosage, its 120s, and the Airborne gate on Last Breath.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer tracks 'Infected Cleaver' — the old name; the ability is Infected Bonesaw. Five content strings call his ultimate 'Sadism'; it is Maximum Dosage. spikes[0] labels Heart Zapper as his E (it is his W), and wants.foe[1] credits the lane sustain to E (it is Heart Zapper plus the passive regen). The Wind Wall interaction itself was correct but appeared without its cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Goes Where He Pleases (P), Infected Bonesaw (Q, 975 range, projectile, 4s), Heart Zapper (W, 17s, stores damage and heals), Blunt Force Trauma (E, auto reset), Maximum Dosage (R, 120s). Infected Bonesaw is the only projectile in the kit, so Wind Wall's 25s rank-1 cooldown is exactly what makes 'wall it' actionable.
audit.corrected: Every 'Infected Cleaver' replaced with Infected Bonesaw — the two names are the same character length so no string changes size. Sadism replaced with Maximum Dosage, Heart Zapper moved to the W slot, and the wall tracker now reads '975-range poke. Wind Wall it, 25s.'

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Wind Walling' in spikes[2] as a probable wrong name. False positive — it is the verb form of Wind Wall, not a misspelt ability.

notes: Two stale ability names ran through this whole entry: Infected Cleaver (now Infected Bonesaw) and Sadism (now Maximum Dosage). The packet's defect scan flagged neither — it flagged 'Wind Walling', which is correct usage. Infected Cleaver and Infected Bonesaw are the same character length, so those swaps do not move any string's size. His passive also resists the first immobilizing effect that hits him, which matters for Last Breath setup; I did not add it because I could not verify from Riot's text whether Steel Tempest's knockup is what the passive eats first — recorded as unverified.
